reviews.text:
I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to your wonderful team for the incredible care, kindness and love you show our precious Ellie! ❤️🐶

Every time she visits your salon, she comes home looking absolutely gorgeous! Beautifully groomed, smelling amazing, and looking like a little princess! 🥰

What I appreciate most is how carefully you listen to all our preferences, pay attention to every little detail, and genuinely care about the dogs you look after. Most importantly, Ellie is never afraid to come to you! And to me, that says everything about how comfortable and safe she feels in your hands.

We are so happy that you opened your salon in Clongriffin! We live just around the corner, so having such a wonderful grooming salon nearby is incredibly convenient.

We are definitely your loyal and very happy customers! ❤️

I sincerely wish your business continued success, growth and prosperity, lots of lovely clients and plenty of sweet, well-behaved furry visitors! 🐾

May your business continue to grow and bring you as much happiness as you bring to us and our beloved pets!

Thank you so much for everything you do! ❤️🐶
Absolutely lovely groomers , the best groom my dog has had in ages . Very gentle with nervous dogs and we will definitely come back 🙂
Very happy with shaggy pawlor and the groom they gave our dog. Will be coming back again

Really happy with our dog’s first visit! She’s a very nervous dog and has been a bit snappy with groomers in the past, so I was a little nervous bringing her somewhere new.
Jagoda was so patient with her and took her time getting her settled and gaining her trust.
Our dog looks absolutely gorgeous and we’re delighted with her. It’s great to find someone so patient and understanding with a nervous dog. We’ll definitely be back!
We brought Simba in today for a full groom and we are so delighted with how she looks. I can tell Simba is chuffed with her cut. The staff are so friendly. Highly recommend!!
Bailey is so used to Rachel, she is amazing with him. She takes her time and her work is great. Lovely person too. 🫶
Excellent Job . Great location.  Competitive pricing . I brought two scruffy Pomskis to Jagoda and left with two sparkling princes 🤴 . They howled the place down 😅. Thank you and see you again 😇 …

We booked our dog in with Jagoda, and we could not been happier. Booking was seamless, our dog is anxious at groomers (bad experience else where and now doesn't like going) she was perfect with him. Happy pup and a great cut just how we describe to her. Rebooked on the spot and would recommend to anyone

Great staff, and my babies look amazing !
Im definatelly coming back !
Thank you so much for the excellent service for my two dogs penny and poppy,it was a fantastic groom you did for them.I will certainly be back again.Regards Cora

Really impressed with the attention to detail. My dog  Olaf came back looking exactly how I asked and you could tell the groom wasn't rushed. The salon is spotless, the atmosphere is calm and it's obvious the dogs are treated with genuine care.
Thank you Jagoda. We'll definitely be back.
Amazing service provided
Jagoda did an amazing job and Daisy was very happy with the service and her new haircut 😃 definitely will be coming back for more. Totally recommend. 🐶

I couldn't be happier with the service! Jagoda took amazing care of my dog from start to finish, and the grooming was absolutely wonderful. My dog looked fantastic when I picked her up, and it was clear that every detail had been given careful attention.

The whole experience was excellent. Booking was quick, easy, and completely hassle-free. Jagoda worked efficiently without compromising on quality, and her professionalism really stood out.

Her customer service is truly outstanding. She is such a caring, friendly, and always smiling lady who genuinely loves what she does. Her attention to detail and the way she treats both dogs and their owners make the experience exceptional.

I highly recommend this grooming salon to anyone looking for top-quality care for their dog. Thank you, Jagoda, for the fantastic service—I will definitely be coming back in the future!

I took my dog in for a bath. Since he came from Brazil, he hadn’t had a proper bath, hahaha.

The girls took very good care of him. They were very attentive and careful with him.

We’ll be coming back more often!

Thank you for taking such good care of my little boy

- Batman

Got an appointment within a week and Jagoda was very warm, welcoming and professional. The space itself is very clean and spacious. I have tried a number of dog groomers over the years of having dogs and this one stands out. Every bit of attention to detail and we got exactly what we asked for and more. Nothing was left undone or unfinished. Sometimes other places will forget nails, miss a spot, just take the easiest or quickest option but not here. They went above and beyond and took great care of our dog and were very flexible. Price is not too dissimilar to other groomers. 90euro is well spent here but if extra work (unexpected) is required during the groom for your dog, expect it to be a little more but still worth it. Thank you and glad we found you. Definitely will return.
Jagoda did such a great job on my Maltese. Will definitely be back!

Jagoda did an amazing job with my dog. She was very professional, caring, and attentive to every detail. My dog looked absolutely adorable after the grooming session. I’m very happy with the result and would highly recommend her services! ❤️🐶 …
I had my puppy groomed by Jagoda yesterday. Very friendly and welcoming from the start. She looked after him very well and did a great job.
Great grooming service, happy dog and good price
Jagoda shes brilliant. She took us last minute and she did a great job.

I usually have to get my dog knocked out at the vets for a nail trim, 2 weeks ago we brought him here and the lady was fantastic with him. Nails done and a happy dog he keeps trying to go back in when we pass !!!
Excellent groomers. I took my three dogs there and they had a great time.  They came home very well groomed and looked after.  We will be returning.  Love this place
Jagoda did an amazing job, from start till end, she focused on tayloring the grooming outcome to your preference. My pup is high energy and Jagoda handled her perfectly. Highly recommend visiting!
Great service! Definitely will be back, worth the price..
Kobe looked amazing coming back from his grooming session.  would highly recommend. Kobe was so cute and the staff so nice thanks again guys 🐶 …
My dog Loki came out of here looking 5 years younger. Very happy with the service. Loki even more so
Great experience, highly recommend😃 The best in the area.She did a brilliant job with my dog❤️ …
Staff was really helpful and super friendly with my puppy. They made us both feel very welcome — such a great experience!!
We had our 2 dogs groomed here today. Jagoda did an excellent job. Lovely place, would highly recommend!
